4 [[Asksvin Hide]] | movement speed = -5% | resistance = Heat Resistance +20% }} }} '''Flametal Armor''' is an [[Ashlands]]-tier [[armor]]. This set is the tier above [[Carapace Armor]] and [[Eitr-weave Set]] and currently has the highest armor value in the game. Equal level sets include [[Embla Set]] and [[Ask Set]]. == Armor pieces == This set of armor has three pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the [[Black Forge]]. Flametal armor's heat resistance reduces the damage done by [[Lava]] and extends the time without taking damage in [[Ashlands#Boiling water|Boiling water]].
